jobs.title: Principal AI Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description:
Principal AI Infrastructure Readiness Architect, Pre-Sales

Location: UK/ME - Travel up to 50% across EU, UK, and Middle East for technical design workshops and on-site infrastructure assessments.

About The Role:
As enterprises race to deploy AI at scale, infrastructure bottlenecks often appear well before a single server ships. This role sits at the frontlines—assessing and shaping the physical environments that must support high-density AI workloads.

You'll act as a domain expert across power, cooling, rack layout, MEP systems, and construction feasibility. You'll lead readiness assessments across brownfield sites and greenfield builds—often influencing some of the largest capital decisions our customers will make.

Key Responsibilities:
- Evaluate data center readiness for high-density AI deployments (power capacity, cooling strategy, physical layout, facility compliance)
- Lead greenfield and brownfield technical assessments to determine build vs. retrofit strategy
- Collaborate with OEMs (NVIDIA, Dell), facility owners, and build partners
- Guide and review data center designs with attention to MEP requirements
- Shape and validate modular data center designs and pod configurations
- Develop reference architectures, playbooks, and BOM templates
- Conduct site audits and readiness reviews
- Stay current on international building codes and compliance requirements

You Should Have:
- 10+ years in data center engineering, infrastructure architecture, or technical facility planning
- Proven experience with data center buildouts or retrofits, ideally involving AI/HPC workloads
- Deep understanding of power distribution, cooling systems (air/liquid), and physical infrastructure
- Knowledge of MEP systems and construction permitting
- Experience working with OEMs like NVIDIA, Dell, HPE on high-density deployments

Note: This is a PHYSICAL INFRASTRUCTURE role, not software/cloud architecture
jobs.notes: CAUTION: Physical infrastructure role, NOT software/AI architecture. Heavy travel (50%). May not be suitable for software-focused architect.
